## Install matching skills

Use the preset skill for its audit-plugin integration and collection design for Payload boundaries. There is no dedicated hooks skill.

### payload-preset

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload-preset/SKILL.md)

```text
Use when configuring or reviewing Payload CMS configuration with @nexload-sdk/payload-preset, composing Persian admin defaults, logger bridge, field hooks, or collection audit logging with auditPlugin. Decides between preset and standalone plugins, validates options and defaults, verifies plugin order and non-interference with collection fields, or migrates from deprecated logOperation. Do not use for field schema definitions (use payload-schema) or single field customizations (use payload-fields).
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-preset
```

### payload-collection-design

[Trigger](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/skills/payload/collection-design/SKILL.md)

```text
Design, name, review, and refactor Payload CMS collections and PostgreSQL-backed data relationships. Use whenever choosing embedded fields versus Globals or collections, modeling cardinality and ownership, defining junction collections, naming resources and fields, selecting indexes and constraints, setting deletion behavior, preserving historical snapshots, or auditing a Payload schema for data-model correctness.
```

```bash
npx skills add gecut/nexload-sdk --skill payload-collection-design
```

## Exported Factories Summary

`auditPlugin(options?: AuditPluginOptions): Plugin` attaches audit hooks. `AUDIT_PLUGIN_ORDER` is `1000`. `AuditOperation` is `"create" | "update" | "delete" | "read" | "auth"`. `logOperation` is deprecated; see the [migration guide](../guides/).

# Production Guides & Recipes

Audit options, events, privacy, and migration.

**Topic:** guides
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks` v3.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-hooks/guides/
## Audit options

| Option | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collections` | `"all"` | All collections or an array of slugs. |
| `exclude` | `[]` | Slugs to skip. Unknown requested or excluded slugs throw at config time. |
| `operations` | `["create", "update", "delete", "auth"]` | Enabled operations; add `"read"` to audit reads. |
| `logger` | SDK default logger | Custom logger with an `info` method. |

The plugin runs at order 1000 and appends hooks after existing hooks. Writes log once per document. Reads are off by default; when enabled, each request produces one list summary or single-read event. Auth auditing is on by default for auth collections; failed logins are not logged. Logging failures do not interrupt operations. Events contain identifiers and counts, never document bodies, emails, tokens, or other credentials.

## Events

* `payload.document.created`
* `payload.document.updated`
* `payload.document.deleted`
* `payload.documents.listed`
* `payload.document.read`
* `payload.auth.logged_in`
* `payload.auth.password_reset_requested`
* `payload.auth.password_reset`

Write event IDs may be absent. List events include a count rather than document contents or IDs.

## Boundaries

Payload creates its implicit default `users` collection after plugins run. Declare the auth collection explicitly to audit its auth and write events. Write hooks emit events before transaction commit, so a later rollback can leave an event for a change that did not persist.

## Migrate from `logOperation`

`logOperation` is deprecated. Remove per-collection hooks and register the plugin once:

```ts
// Before: hooks: { afterChange: [logOperation("afterChange")] }
import { auditPlugin } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks";

const plugins = [auditPlugin()];
```

The preset also includes `auditPlugin` by default; do not register it twice. See [Payload Preset](/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-preset/).

---

# Overview & Quick Start

Audit Payload collection operations with structured log events.

**Topic:** overview
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks` v3.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-hooks/
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks`

**Workspace version:** `3.0.0`

Effortless, type-safe logging for Payload CMS collection operations.

[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks) · [Source](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/tree/main/packages/payload-hooks)

`auditPlugin` attaches log-only collection hooks. It stores no audit records and does not change collection fields.

**Upcoming release:** this page documents `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks` 3.0.0, which ships with the next Changesets release and is not on npm yet.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @nexload-sdk/payload-hooks payload
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { auditPlugin } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks";

const plugins = [auditPlugin({ operations: ["create", "update", "delete", "read", "auth"] })];
```

Reads are off by default; auth is on for auth collections. See [guides](./guides/) for event names, options, and transaction caveats. Payload `>=3.85.0 <4.0.0` is a peer dependency; the hooks run in Node.js Payload configuration.

## Next steps

# payload-hooks — Optimization

Production choices for @nexload-sdk/payload-hooks.

**Topic:** optimization
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks` v3.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-hooks/optimization/
## Declare the auth collection

Declare an auth collection in the config to include it in auditing. Payload creates its implicit users collection after plugins run.

## Interpret write events in context

Write events from afterChange and afterDelete run before the database transaction commits.

## Avoid read auditing by default

Read auditing is off by default. When enabled, `find` logs once per request with a count, while `findByID` logs the document ID.

## Treat audit output as logs

The plugin does not persist database audit records. Authentication auditing covers successful logins and password resets, not failed logins.

## Sources

[Package guidance](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/packages/payload-hooks/README.md) · [Implementation](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/packages/payload-hooks/src/index.ts).
